desc: Read N and the set S from stdin.
Compute maxV = max(S) and FFT size (next power of two ≥ 2*maxV + 1).
Build float array f of length size, set f[v] = 1.0 for v in S.
Compute FFT, square the result, inverse FFT to get convolution g.
For each B in S, compute s = 2*B; if s odd add g[s] // 2; if even add (g[s] - f[s//2]) // 2.
Sum over all B and output the total count.
